description.en: Cut AI tells from any writing.
description.zh: 从任何文字里去掉一看就是 AI 写的痕迹。

blocks.en: Edit text to remove AI patterns. Scan for the patterns below, then rewrite. Preserve meaning and match the intended tone.
blocks.zh: 编辑文字，去掉 AI 的写作套路。先按下面的套路扫一遍，再改写。保留原意，贴合原本想要的语气。

blocks.en: Rule numbers are stable ids that other skills cite. A removed rule leaves a gap.
blocks.zh: 规则编号是固定的 id，别的技能会引用它们。删掉的规则会留下一个空号。

blocks.en:
3. No trailing "-ing" phrases that add no fact ("highlighting...", "ensuring...").
5. No vague attributions ("experts believe"). Name the source or delete.
7. No AI vocabulary: additionally, crucial, delve, enhance, foster, landscape, pivotal, showcase, testament, underscore, vibrant.
8. Say "is" or "has", not "serves as", "stands as", "boasts", "features".
9. No "not just X, but Y". State the point.
10. Don't force ideas into threes.
11. One name per thing. Repeat it.
12. No "from X to Y" unless X and Y sit on a real scale.
13. No em dashes, en dashes, or hyphens used as dashes, and no parentheses in their place. Use a period or a comma.
14. A colon goes before a list or an example, never mid-sentence as a connector.
15. Don't bold every proper noun or acronym.
16. No bold label and colon that restates its line ("**Performance:** Performance improved..."). A bold lead-in that ends in a period and adds new detail is fine.
17. Sentence case headings.
18. No decorative emojis.
19. Straight quotes.
20. No chatbot phrases ("I hope this helps!", "Let me know if...").
22. No praise or agreement openers. Respond directly.
23. Cut filler. "In order to" becomes "to". Delete "it is important to note that".
24. One hedge at most: "may".
25. No generic conclusions. State specific plans or facts.
26. No abstract metaphor nouns: substrate, wedge, vector, nexus, primitive, harness, surface, scaffolding, paradigm, ratchet, north star, flywheel. Use the concrete word.
27. Say what it does, not how it feels. Name the mechanism or the number. Cut a sentence that could appear unchanged in another project's docs.
28. One idea per sentence. Split a sentence the reader has to reread.
29. Active voice. Name the actor unless it is unknown or doesn't matter.
30. Cut adverbs or use a stronger verb. Give the number.
31. Use the plain word: "use", not "utilize" or "leverage".
32. No metaphor, aphorism, personified code, or figurative verb where a literal phrase exists.
33. Write whole sentences with their articles and verbs. Spell out arrows and abbreviations.
blocks.zh:
3. 不在句尾挂不添任何事实的「-ing」短语（「highlighting...」「ensuring...」）。
5. 不写含糊的出处（「experts believe」）。写出来源，或者删掉。
7. 不用 AI 词汇：additionally, crucial, delve, enhance, foster, landscape, pivotal, showcase, testament, underscore, vibrant。
8. 说「is」或「has」，不说「serves as」「stands as」「boasts」「features」。
9. 不写「not just X, but Y」。直接说出要点。
10. 不要硬把想法凑成三个一组。
11. 一样东西只用一个名字。重复用它。
12. 不写「from X to Y」，除非 X 和 Y 在一个真实的刻度上。
13. 不用 em dash、en dash，不拿连字符当破折号，也不用括号代替它们。用句号或逗号。
14. 冒号放在列表或例子前面，绝不放在句子中间当连接词。
15. 不要把每个专有名词或缩写都加粗。
16. 不用加粗标签加冒号来重复这一行的内容（「**Performance:** Performance improved...」）。以句号结尾、后面补充了新细节的加粗开头没问题。
17. 标题用句子式大小写。
18. 不用装饰用的 emoji。
19. 用直引号。
20. 不用聊天机器人用语（「I hope this helps!」「Let me know if...」）。
22. 不用夸奖或附和开头。直接回应。
23. 删掉凑字的话。「In order to」改成「to」。删掉「it is important to note that」。
24. 含糊的说法最多一处：「may」。
25. 不写空泛的结尾。写出具体的计划或事实。
26. 不用抽象的比喻名词：substrate, wedge, vector, nexus, primitive, harness, surface, scaffolding, paradigm, ratchet, north star, flywheel。用具体的词。
27. 说它做什么，不说它给人什么感觉。写出机制或数字。原封不动放进另一个项目的文档里也说得通的句子，删掉。
28. 一句话一个意思。读者得重读的句子，拆开。
29. 用主动语态。点出是谁做的，除非不知道是谁，或者是谁无关紧要。
30. 删掉副词，或者换一个更有力的动词。给出数字。
31. 用平常的词：说「use」，不说「utilize」或「leverage」。
32. 有字面说法的地方，不用比喻、格言、拟人化的代码或比喻性的动词。
33. 写完整的句子，带上冠词和动词。把箭头和缩写写成字。

lessons.quote: Rule numbers are stable ids that other skills cite.
lessons.quoteZh: 规则编号是固定的 id，别的技能会引用它们。

zh.title: 给每条规则编固定的号
zh.does: 别的技能可以直接说「按第 13 条改」，增删规则后也不会对错号。
zh.why: 编号固定下来，引用就短又准，不会因为清单改动而错位。
zh.try: 把团队的写作规矩编上号，评审时直接说：「这段违反了第 4 条。」

en.title: Give each rule a fixed number
en.does: Other skills can just say "apply rule 13", and the numbers still line up after rules are added or removed.
en.why: Fixed numbers make references short and exact, and they don't shift when the list changes.
en.try: Number your team's writing rules, then say in a review: "This paragraph breaks rule 4."

lessons.quote: Name the actor unless it is unknown or doesn't matter.
lessons.quoteZh: 点出是谁做的，除非不知道是谁，或者是谁无关紧要。

zh.title: 规则带上例外
zh.does: 它把被动句改成写出动作是谁做的，只有不知道是谁、或是谁无关紧要时才保留被动。
zh.why: 规则里直接写明例外，AI 就不会一刀切，把本该保留的被动句也硬改掉。
zh.try: 提要求时顺手写出例外：「每段都加小标题，只有一两句的短段除外。」

en.title: Write the exception into the rule
en.does: It rewrites passive sentences to name who acts, and keeps the passive only when the actor is unknown or doesn't matter.
en.why: Stating the exception inside the rule stops the AI from rewriting every passive sentence, including the ones that should stay.
en.try: Put the exception in the request: "Give every paragraph a subheading, except paragraphs of one or two sentences."

lessons.quote: Cut a sentence that could appear unchanged in another project's docs.
lessons.quoteZh: 原封不动放进另一个项目的文档里也说得通的句子，删掉。

zh.title: 用「搬到别处」来测空话
zh.does: 放到哪个项目都成立的套话会被删掉，留下的句子都在说这个项目自己。
zh.why: 「空话」不好判断，「搬过去还成立吗」是一个马上能做的小实验。
zh.try: 让 AI 改简介时加一句：「换成竞品的名字也成立的句子，删掉。」

en.title: Test filler by moving it
en.does: Sentences that would fit any project get cut; what stays is about this project.
en.why: "Filler" is hard to judge, but "would it still fit elsewhere?" is a quick test anyone can run.
en.try: When you ask for an intro edit, add: "Delete any sentence that stays true with a competitor's name in it."

lessons.quote: One name per thing. Repeat it.
lessons.quoteZh: 一样东西只用一个名字。重复用它。

zh.title: 明说可以重复
zh.does: 同一样东西从头到尾用同一个词，它不会为了显得有变化换成同义词。
zh.why: 「Repeat it」直接允许重复，AI 就不会把一个东西换着叫，让读者以为是好几样东西。
zh.try: 改文案时加一句：「全文统一叫『订单』，不要换成『单子』『购买记录』。」

en.title: Say repetition is fine
en.does: It calls one thing by one word from start to finish instead of cycling through synonyms for variety.
en.why: "Repeat it" gives explicit permission, so the AI stops renaming one thing until readers think it is several.
en.try: When you ask for an edit, add: "Call it 'order' everywhere. Don't switch to 'purchase' or 'transaction'."

compare.without: 写只讲感觉的句子，放进哪个项目的文档都说得通
compare.with: 写出机制或数字，换个项目就不成立的句子才留下

compare.without: 写「专家认为」，不说是哪位专家
compare.with: 写出具体来源，写不出就删掉

compare.without: 开头先夸或附和，结尾问「还需要别的吗」
compare.with: 删掉客套和奉承，直接回答

zh.intro: 先按下面的套路扫一遍再改写，意思和语气不变。规则编号固定，供别的技能引用，删掉的留空号。清单一行一条，从空 -ing 短语、AI 词汇、破折号，到客套话、抽象比喻名词和被动语态。

compare.without: Writes feel-good lines that would fit any project's docs.
compare.with: Names the mechanism or a number, and cuts lines that would fit another project unchanged.
Names the source, or deletes the claim.

compare.without: Opens with praise or agreement and closes with "Let me know if...".
compare.with: Drops the pleasantries and flattery and answers directly.

en.intro: It scans for the patterns below, then rewrites, keeping the meaning and the intended tone. Rule numbers are fixed ids other skills cite. The list gives one line per rule, from empty -ing phrases, AI words and dashes to chatbot phrases, metaphor nouns and passive voice.
